blocks.zh: 特異性、準確度、重複性與偵測極限
blocks.en: Specificity, Accuracy, Repeatability and Limit of Detection

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Specificity（特異性）、Accuracy（準確度）、Repeatability（重複性）、Limit of Detection（LoD，偵測極限）四項驗證參數的定義、彼此關係，以及為何 Specificity 不需要獨立試驗
blocks.en: Understand the definitions of the four validation parameters Specificity, Accuracy, Repeatability and Limit of Detection (LoD), how they relate to one another, and why Specificity does not need a separate study

blocks.zh: 掌握 TOST（Two One-Sided Equivalence Test）、Levene's test、probit/logit analysis、MPN（Most Probable Number）等統計方法如何套用在 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 的比對設計上
blocks.en: Master how statistical methods such as TOST (Two One-Sided Equivalence Test), Levene's test, probit/logit analysis and MPN (Most Probable Number) are applied in the design of comparisons between an AMM/RMM and the CMM

blocks.zh: 學會判讀常見允收標準背後的統計意義，例如 comparability margin（Δ = 0.3 對應比值區間 [0.7, 1.3]）與重複性的 0.5 / 0.693 界線
blocks.en: Learn to interpret the statistical meaning behind common acceptance criteria, such as the comparability margin (Δ = 0.3, corresponding to a ratio interval of [0.7, 1.3]) and the 0.5 / 0.693 limits for repeatability

blocks.zh: 能將本節內容連結到 CDMO 實務中 AMM/RMM 導入驗證計畫的試驗設計、樣本數規劃與法規溝通策略
blocks.en: Be able to link the content of this section to study design, sample size planning and regulatory communication strategy in the AMM/RMM validation plan of a CDMO

blocks.zh: 5.4.1 Specificity 特異性
blocks.en: 5.4.1 Specificity

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Specificity（特異性）：指方法能正確辨識「該偵測的微生物」（inclusivity，涵蓋性）並排除「不該被誤判為陽性的物種」（exclusivity，排他性）的能力。這裡最關鍵的一句話是：Specificity 不需要獨立設計一個試驗——它是「附掛」在 Accuracy、Repeatability、LoD、LoQ、Method Suitability、Comparability 等其他試驗上一併展示的。也就是說，只要你在做這些試驗時，選用了一組具代表性的微生物 panel（Gram 陰性/陽性桿菌、產孢菌、Gram 陽性球菌、酵母菌、黴菌），Specificity 就已經被證明了，不必額外燒錢燒時間再開一個試驗。
blocks.en: Specificity: The ability of the method to correctly identify "the microorganisms that should be detected" (inclusivity) and to exclude "species that should not be misjudged as positive" (exclusivity). The most important sentence here is: Specificity does not need a separately designed study. It is demonstrated "attached" to other studies such as Accuracy, Repeatability, LoD, LoQ, Method Suitability and Comparability. In other words, as long as you use a representative panel of microorganisms (Gram-negative/Gram-positive rods, spore formers, Gram-positive cocci, yeast, mold) in those studies, Specificity has already been demonstrated, and there is no need to spend extra money and time on another study.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 AMM/RMM 想像成夜店門口的保全：Inclusivity（涵蓋性）是「賓客名單上的人都要能順利進場」，Exclusivity（排他性）是「名單外的人、甚至長得很像賓客的人都不能混進去」。保全不需要另外辦一場「認人測試日」——他每天站崗值勤（也就是做 Accuracy、Repeatability、LoD 等其他任務）時，自然而然就在持續驗證自己認人的能力。這就是為什麼 Specificity 不用獨立試驗的道理。
blocks.en: Think of the AMM/RMM as a security guard at a nightclub door: Inclusivity means "everyone on the guest list must be able to enter smoothly", and Exclusivity means "nobody off the list, even someone who looks very like a guest, can slip in". The guard does not need a separate "face recognition test day". Every day on duty (that is, doing the other tasks such as Accuracy, Repeatability and LoD) he is naturally verifying his ability to recognize people. That is why Specificity needs no separate study.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 兩個常被忽略卻很重要的操作限制：(1) Nonviable cells（非存活細胞）不應被偵測為陽性——對非生長型（nongrowth-based）技術特別關鍵，因為這類技術可能偵測到「屍體」訊號而產生 false-positive；驗證非存活細胞的製備方式（熱處理、殺菌劑處理）通常放在 Method Suitability 階段執行，而非 Specificity 本身。(2) Stressed organisms（逆境菌株）不建議使用，因為目前全球沒有公認的「逆境菌株製備標準」——換句話說，用了逆境菌株做出來的數據，你在法規機關面前可能無法自圓其說「這個逆境程度具有科學代表性」。
blocks.en: Two operational limits that are often overlooked but important: (1) Nonviable cells should not be detected as positive. This is especially critical for nongrowth-based technologies, because they may detect the signal of "dead cells" and give a false positive. The preparation of nonviable cells for verification (heat treatment, biocide treatment) is usually carried out at the Method Suitability stage rather than as part of Specificity itself. (2) Stressed organisms are not recommended, because there is currently no globally accepted "standard for preparing stressed organisms". In other words, if you use stressed organisms, you may be unable to justify before a regulatory authority that "this level of stress is scientifically representative".

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這條規則其實是「省成本」的關鍵設計：如果你在規劃 AMM/RMM 驗證方案時，把 Specificity panel 直接嵌入 Accuracy 與 LoD 試驗的菌株選擇中（例如兩個試驗共用同一組 8-10 株代表性微生物），就能一次滿足多個驗證準則的數據需求，減少重複備菌、重複跑批的人力與物料成本。這也是 PROMPT.md 開頭提到「一份試驗數據可支援多個驗證準則」精神的具體實例（見 5.4 節前言：linearity 的數據也可用於 accuracy）。
blocks.en: For a CDMO this rule is in fact a key "cost-saving" design: if, when planning the AMM/RMM validation protocol, you embed the Specificity panel directly in the choice of organisms for the Accuracy and LoD studies (for example, both studies sharing the same set of 8-10 representative microorganisms), you can meet the data needs of several validation criteria at once and cut the labor and material cost of repeated organism preparation and repeated runs. This is also a concrete instance of the principle that "one set of study data can support multiple validation criteria" (see the introduction to Section 5.4: the linearity data can also be used for accuracy).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你的 AMM/RMM 是設計來偵測單一目標菌（如 S. aureus）的專一性方法，Specificity panel 的設計邏輯會和「廣譜型」方法有何不同？
blocks.en: If your AMM/RMM is a specific method designed to detect a single target organism (such as S. aureus), how would the design logic of the Specificity panel differ from that of a "broad-spectrum" method?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「非存活細胞不應被偵測」這件事對非生長型技術特別重要，對生長型（growth-based）技術反而不是核心考量？
blocks.en: Why is "nonviable cells should not be detected" especially important for nongrowth-based technologies, and not a core consideration for growth-based technologies?

blocks.zh: 若監管單位質疑你「沒有做獨立的 Specificity 試驗」，你會如何用 5.4.1 的原文邏輯來回應？
blocks.en: If a regulatory authority challenges you for "not performing a separate Specificity study", how would you respond using the logic of the source text in 5.4.1?

blocks.zh: 5.4.2 Accuracy 準確度
blocks.en: 5.4.2 Accuracy

blocks.zh: Accuracy（準確度）：衡量 AMM/RMM 的計數結果和參考方法 CMM（Compendial Microbiological Method，藥典微生物方法）之間有多接近「真值」。做法是準備一系列稀釋濃度，每株菌至少 5 重複，AMM/RMM 與 CMM 平行（parallel）挑戰同一批菌液，比較兩者的平均回收率（mean recovery）。Parallel testing（平行測試）是關鍵設計：同一批菌液同時餵給兩種方法，才能用「配對」（paired）統計檢定，排除批次間差異這個干擾因子。
blocks.en: Accuracy: Measures how close the AMM/RMM counting results are to the "true value", using the reference method, the CMM (compendial microbiological method). The approach is to prepare a series of dilution levels, with at least 5 replicates per organism, challenge the AMM/RMM and the CMM in parallel with the same suspension, and compare the mean recovery of the two. Parallel testing is the key design: only by feeding the same suspension to both methods at the same time can a paired statistical test be used to eliminate batch-to-batch difference as a confounding factor.

blocks.zh: Accuracy 驗證就像拿一把新的體重計（AMM/RMM）跟醫院認證過的體重計（CMM）比較：你不會只秤一次就下結論，而是找同一個人，在同一天、用同一組人（平行測試），分別在兩台秤上量體重，看兩邊數字是否「在合理誤差內一致」。如果新秤系統性地偏高或偏低超過可接受範圍，就代表新秤不準確。TOST 就是那把「合理誤差內」的量尺。
blocks.en: Accuracy validation is like comparing a new bathroom scale (AMM/RMM) with a hospital-certified scale (CMM): you would not weigh once and draw a conclusion. You would take the same person, on the same day, with the same group of people (parallel testing), weigh them on both scales, and see whether the two readings "agree within reasonable error". If the new scale is systematically too high or too low beyond the acceptable range, it is not accurate. TOST is the yardstick for "within reasonable error".

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
TOST（Two One-Sided Equivalence Test）等效性判定：

  比較 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 的期望計數比值 (ratio)
  comparability margin = 0.7   →   Δ = 1 - 0.7 = 0.3

  等效區間：[ 1 - Δ , 1 + Δ ]  =  [ 0.7 , 1.3 ]

  判定規則：
    若 90% CI（雙邊等效）或 95% CI（單邊 noninferiority）
    完全落在 [0.7, 1.3] 之內  → 判定「comparable / equivalent」
    落在區間外                → 判定「不具可比性」

  分布假設對應統計方法：
    Poisson / Negative-Binomial 分布  → 對數連結函數的迴歸分析
    無母數（無法假設分布）            → nonparametric CI（檢定力較低）
    多濃度同時考量                    → 濃度-反應曲線迴歸模型
    常態分布（近似）                  → paired 或 independent t-test 的 TOST
blocks.en:
TOST (Two One-Sided Equivalence Test) equivalence determination:

  Compare the expected count ratio (ratio) of the AMM/RMM and the CMM
  comparability margin = 0.7   →   Δ = 1 - 0.7 = 0.3

  Equivalence interval: [ 1 - Δ , 1 + Δ ]  =  [ 0.7 , 1.3 ]

  Decision rule:
    If the 90% CI (two-sided equivalence) or 95% CI (one-sided noninferiority)
    falls entirely within [0.7, 1.3]  → judged "comparable / equivalent"
    If it falls outside the interval  → judged "not comparable"

  Statistical method according to distribution assumption:
    Poisson / Negative-Binomial distribution  → regression analysis with a log link function
    Nonparametric (distribution cannot be assumed)  → nonparametric CI (lower power)
    Several concentrations considered together  → concentration-response curve regression model
    Normal distribution (approximate)  → TOST using a paired or independent t-test

blocks.zh: 常見誤解：Δ = 0.3 不是「30% 的容許誤差」本身，而是「1 減去 comparability margin（0.7）」。原文特別強調這點澄清，因為很多人會把 Δ 直接誤讀為容許誤差百分比。此外，AMM/RMM 若「比 CMM 更敏感、計數統計上顯著更高」，應該改用 noninferiority test（非劣性檢定）而非雙邊等效性檢定——因為此時目標不是「證明兩者一樣」，而是「證明新方法不會比較差」，方向性不同，統計設計也不同。
blocks.en: Common misunderstanding: Δ = 0.3 is not itself a "30% tolerance for error"; it is "1 minus the comparability margin (0.7)". The source specifically stresses this clarification because many people misread Δ directly as a percentage error tolerance. In addition, if the AMM/RMM is "more sensitive than the CMM, with counts statistically significantly higher", a noninferiority test should be used instead of the two-sided equivalence test. The goal in this case is not to "prove the two are the same" but to "prove the new method is not worse", and since the direction differs, so does the statistical design.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 導入新型 AMM/RMM（如自動化菌落計數系統取代傳統平板培養）時，Accuracy 試驗的統計方法選擇直接牽動驗證時程與樣本數：選錯統計模型（例如硬套常態分布 t-test 到低濃度、右偏的菌落計數資料）可能導致檢定力不足、需要重做試驗，拖延方法上線時程並增加委託客戶等待成本。及早根據資料分布特性（Poisson vs. Negative-Binomial vs. 無母數）選對統計工具，是縮短驗證週期、降低返工風險的關鍵決策點。
blocks.en: When a CDMO introduces a new type of AMM/RMM (such as an automated colony counting system replacing traditional plate culture), the choice of statistical method for the Accuracy study directly affects the validation timeline and sample size. Choosing the wrong statistical model (for example, forcing a normal-distribution t-test onto low-level, right-skewed colony count data) can lead to insufficient power and the need to repeat the study, delaying go-live of the method and increasing the waiting cost for client sponsors. Choosing the right statistical tool early, based on the characteristics of the data distribution (Poisson vs. Negative-Binomial vs. nonparametric), is a key decision point for shortening the validation cycle and lowering the risk of rework.

blocks.zh: 如果你的菌落計數資料在低濃度時變異度特別大（overdispersion），你會選擇 Poisson 還是 Negative-Binomial 迴歸？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your colony count data show particularly large variability at low concentrations (overdispersion), would you choose Poisson or Negative-Binomial regression? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「同一批菌液平行測試」比「不同批菌液分別測試」更適合用 paired t-test？
blocks.en: Why is "parallel testing with the same suspension" more suitable for a paired t-test than "testing different suspensions separately"?

blocks.zh: 假設你的 90% CI 落在 [0.65, 1.1]，這樣的結果會被判定為 comparable 嗎？該如何跟品保部門解釋原因？
blocks.en: Suppose your 90% CI falls at [0.65, 1.1]. Would this result be judged comparable? How would you explain the reason to the quality assurance department?

blocks.zh: 5.4.3 Repeatability 重複性
blocks.en: 5.4.3 Repeatability

blocks.zh: Repeatability（重複性，又稱 within-run variability 批內變異）：指同一位分析師、同一台設備、同一實驗室，對「同一批菌液」重複取樣測試時，結果之間的一致程度。務必區分它跟 Intermediate Precision（中間精密度，又稱 ruggedness 穩健性）的差別——後者是刻意讓「不同天、不同人、不同設備」這些會在日常操作中自然變動的條件介入，測試方法在這些變動下是否依然穩定（本節只談 Repeatability，Intermediate Precision 留到 5.4.8）。
blocks.en: Repeatability (also called within-run variability): The degree of agreement between results when the same analyst, the same equipment and the same laboratory repeatedly sample and test "the same suspension". Be sure to distinguish it from Intermediate Precision (also called ruggedness). The latter deliberately introduces conditions that naturally vary in routine operation ("different days, different people, different equipment") to test whether the method remains stable under those variations (this section deals only with Repeatability; Intermediate Precision is covered in 5.4.8).

blocks.zh: Repeatability 就像同一位廚師、同一天、用同一鍋高湯，連續做五碗一樣的湯，嚐起來鹹淡是否一致——這測試的是「同一個人同一次做的穩定度」。Intermediate Precision 則是換成不同廚師、不同天、甚至不同廚房來做同一道菜，看味道是否還能維持水準——這測的是「換了條件之後還可靠嗎」。兩者都重要，但驗證設計和數據解讀方式不同。
blocks.en: Repeatability is like the same cook, on the same day, using the same pot of stock to make five bowls of the same soup in a row, and checking whether the saltiness tastes consistent. It tests "the stability of the same person's single session of work". Intermediate Precision is having different cooks, on different days, even in different kitchens, make the same dish and seeing whether the taste still holds up. It tests "is it still reliable after the conditions change". Both are important, but the validation design and the way the data are interpreted differ.

blocks.zh:
Repeatability 統計指標：

  RSD (%) 或 CV = (標準差 SD / 平均計數 mean count) × 100%
  （可用 spiked level 或 mean count 作分母）

  適用前提：mean count > 5 CFU
  低濃度時的下限估計：repeatability ≳ 1 / sqrt(mean count)

  95% CI（變異數）：以 chi-square 分布計算近似信賴區間
  常態分布資料：可用 McKay approximation

與 CMM 比較：
  等變異假設檢定 → Levene's test
                    （建議用 Brown-Forsythe 版本，以中位數取代平均數）

  AMM/RMM 允收標準（comparability margin）：
    比值 (CMM/AMM) 之 margin = 0.5
    或
    ln(RSD) 差異之 margin = 0.693  (= ln(2)，即比值 2 倍的對數)
blocks.en:
Statistical indicators of Repeatability:

  RSD (%) or CV = (standard deviation SD / mean count) × 100%
  (the spiked level or the mean count can be used as the denominator)

  Prerequisite for applicability: mean count > 5 CFU
  Lower-bound estimate at low concentration: repeatability ≳ 1 / sqrt(mean count)

  95% CI (variance): approximate confidence interval calculated with the chi-square distribution
  Normally distributed data: the McKay approximation can be used

Comparison with the CMM:
  Test of equal variances → Levene's test
                    (the Brown-Forsythe version is recommended, using the median instead of the mean)

  AMM/RMM acceptance criterion (comparability margin):
    margin of the ratio (CMM/AMM) = 0.5
    or
    margin of the difference in ln(RSD) = 0.693  (= ln(2), the logarithm of a two-fold ratio)

blocks.zh: 兩個容易忽略的統計前提：(1) Repeatability 計算「最好在 mean count > 5 CFU」時才穩定，濃度太低（<10 CFU）時變異本來就會偏大——這是統計本質使然，不代表方法有問題，而且 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 都會受到相同影響，因此低濃度下的重複性數字要用相對比較（跟 CMM 比），而非用絕對數字評斷方法好壞。(2) Brown-Forsythe 版本的 Levene's test 用「中位數」而非「平均數」計算離差，對偏態（skewed）的菌落計數資料更穩健，這也是為什麼原文特別加註「preferably」。
blocks.en: Two statistical prerequisites that are easily overlooked: (1) The Repeatability calculation is stable "preferably when the mean count is > 5 CFU". At very low concentrations (<10 CFU) variability is naturally larger. This is a matter of statistical nature and does not mean there is a problem with the method, and since both the AMM/RMM and the CMM are affected in the same way, repeatability figures at low concentrations should be judged by relative comparison (against the CMM) rather than by absolute numbers. (2) The Brown-Forsythe version of Levene's test computes deviations from the "median" rather than the "mean", which is more robust for skewed colony count data. This is why the source specifically adds the note "preferably".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 品保與 QC 主管來說，Repeatability 與 Intermediate Precision 若能合併設計（同一組樣本，安排不同天、不同分析師執行），可以用一套試驗方案同時滿足兩項驗證準則的數據需求，這正是原文建議「Repeatability may preferably be combined with ruggedness」的商業意涵：減少額外跑批次數、縮短驗證時程、降低委託客戶等待成本，同時仍完整覆蓋法規要求的統計檢定力。
blocks.en: For the head of QA and QC at a CDMO, if Repeatability and Intermediate Precision can be designed together (the same set of samples, run on different days by different analysts), one study protocol can meet the data needs of both validation criteria. This is the business implication of the source's recommendation that "Repeatability may preferably be combined with ruggedness": fewer extra runs, a shorter validation timeline and lower waiting cost for client sponsors, while still fully covering the statistical power required by regulations.

blocks.zh: 為什麼在低濃度（<10 CFU）挑戰時，重複性數字變差不必然代表方法失敗？
blocks.en: Why does a poorer repeatability figure at low-level (<10 CFU) challenge not necessarily mean the method has failed?

blocks.zh: 比值 margin 0.5 跟自然對數 margin 0.693 這兩種允收標準，本質上是同一件事的兩種表示方式嗎？試著用 ln(2) ≈ 0.693 的關係說明。
blocks.en: Are the ratio margin of 0.5 and the natural logarithm margin of 0.693 essentially two representations of the same thing? Try to explain using the relationship ln(2) ≈ 0.693.

blocks.zh: 若你的 AMM/RMM 樣本間變異明顯小於 CMM（方法更穩定），這對商業銷售或內部效益溝通會是什麼樣的賣點？
blocks.en: If the sample-to-sample variability of your AMM/RMM is clearly smaller than that of the CMM (the method is more stable), what selling point would this be for commercial sales or for communicating internal benefits?

blocks.zh: 5.4.4 Limit of Detection 偵測極限
blocks.en: 5.4.4 Limit of Detection

blocks.zh: LoD（Limit of Detection，偵測極限）：指方法能以特定信心水準（通常是 95%，記作 LoD95）偵測到陽性樣本的「最低微生物濃度」。它主要用於定性（qualitative / presence-absence）方法。重點在於：單點式 LoD（只憑「最低一次測到的濃度」）不夠嚴謹，因為缺乏信心水準的統計基礎；原文建議用 probit analysis（機率單位分析）這種以經驗數據建模的方法，才能算出「在 95% 信心水準下」真正的 LoD95 數值。
blocks.en: LoD (Limit of Detection): The "lowest microbial concentration" at which the method can detect a positive sample with a specified confidence level (usually 95%, written as LoD95). It is mainly used for qualitative (presence/absence) methods. The key point: a single-point LoD (based only on "the lowest concentration detected once") is not rigorous enough, because it lacks a statistical basis for the confidence level. The source recommends probit analysis, a method that models empirical data, in order to calculate the true LoD95 value "at the 95% confidence level".

blocks.zh: LoD 就像測試金屬探測器「最微弱能穩定偵測到的訊號強度」：你不會只埋一枚硬幣測一次就說「這台機器可以測到 5 元硬幣大小的金屬」，而是要在不同深度（不同濃度）埋很多次（20-40 重複），統計出「在這個深度下，有 95% 的機率會被偵測到」的那個臨界深度。稀釋序列的設計（10, 1, 0.1 CFU 或更精細的 5 個濃度點）就像是逐步調整埋藏深度，找出那條 95% 偵測率的分界線。
blocks.en: LoD is like testing "the weakest signal a metal detector can detect reliably": you would not bury one coin once and say "this machine can detect metal the size of a small coin". You bury it many times (20-40 replicates) at different depths (different concentrations) and work out statistically the critical depth at which "there is a 95% probability of detection". The design of the dilution series (10, 1, 0.1 CFU, or a finer set of 5 concentration points) is like adjusting the burial depth step by step to find the boundary line of 95% detection rate.

blocks.zh:
LoD95 試驗設計要點：
  稀釋序列範例： 10, 1, 0.1 CFU
              或  5, 0.5, 0.05 CFU
              或  2, 1.2, 0.7, 0.4, 0.25 CFU（建議用 5 個濃度點，估計較精確）
  每濃度重複數： 至少 20-40 replicates
  若某兩濃度的陽性率剛好是 1 或 0 → 需重新選擇稀釋濃度

統計模型：
  probit / logit analysis（可用稀釋濃度的自然對數）
    → 求出「估計陽性率 = 95%」對應的濃度
    → 以 chi-square goodness-of-fit test 檢驗模型配適度
    → LoD95（實際偵測機率達 95% 的最低菌數）通常低於此估計平均菌數

  特例： LoD 為 1-2 CFU 時 → 可用 Most Probable Limit (MPL) 法，
         視為「近乎完美偵測」，不需再與 CMM 直接比較

AMM/RMM vs. CMM 之 LoD 比較方法：
  ① 標準 MPN（Most Probable Number）法：多次執行、可調整 3 個稀釋濃度
  ② 廣義 gMPN 法：單一稀釋濃度即可比較「偵測比例」
      - gMPN：檢定力較高，但對加菌誤差較不穩健
      - MPN： 較穩健，但需要多個稀釋濃度

允收標準（comparability margin）：
  MPN / 偵測比例比較之 margin = 0.7   →   Δ = 0.3
  等效區間：[1-Δ, 1+Δ] = [0.7, 1.3]（與 Accuracy 的邏輯一致）
blocks.en:
Key points of the LoD95 study design:
  Example dilution series: 10, 1, 0.1 CFU
              or  5, 0.5, 0.05 CFU
              or  2, 1.2, 0.7, 0.4, 0.25 CFU (5 concentration points recommended for a more precise estimate)
  Replicates per concentration: at least 20-40 replicates
  If the positive rate at two concentrations is exactly 1 or 0 → the dilution concentrations must be reselected

Statistical model:
  probit / logit analysis (the natural logarithm of the dilution concentration can be used)
    → find the concentration corresponding to "estimated positive rate = 95%"
    → test the goodness of fit of the model with the chi-square goodness-of-fit test
    → LoD95 (the lowest organism count at which the actual probability of detection reaches 95%) is usually lower than this estimated mean count

  Special case: when the LoD is 1-2 CFU → the Most Probable Limit (MPL) method can be used,
         regarded as "near-perfect detection", with no need for direct comparison with the CMM

Methods for comparing the LoD of the AMM/RMM vs. the CMM:
  (1) Standard MPN (Most Probable Number) method: run multiple times, 3 dilution concentrations can be adjusted
  (2) Generalized gMPN method: a single dilution concentration suffices to compare the "detection proportion"
      - gMPN: higher power, but less robust to inoculation error
      - MPN: more robust, but needs several dilution concentrations

Acceptance criterion (comparability margin):
  margin for the MPN / detection proportion comparison = 0.7   →   Δ = 0.3
  Equivalence interval: [1-Δ, 1+Δ] = [0.7, 1.3] (consistent with the logic for Accuracy)

blocks.zh: 本節的允收標準（Δ = 0.3 → [0.7, 1.3]）與 5.4.2.3 Accuracy 的允收標準公式完全一致，只是套用的統計量不同（LoD 比的是 MPN 或偵測比例，Accuracy 比的是期望計數比值）——這是 TR33 刻意設計的一致性，方便驗證團隊用同一套統計邏輯思維橫跨不同驗證準則。另外要特別留意：當某濃度的陽性率恰好是 100% 或 0% 時，代表這個濃度點沒有提供足夠的資訊量給 probit 模型去估計曲線斜率，必須重新設計稀釋濃度，否則模型配適度會不足。
blocks.en: The acceptance criterion in this section (Δ = 0.3 → [0.7, 1.3]) is exactly the same formula as the acceptance criterion in 5.4.2.3 Accuracy, only applied to a different statistic (LoD compares the MPN or detection proportion, Accuracy compares the ratio of expected counts). This consistency is deliberately designed into TR 33 so that validation teams can use the same statistical way of thinking across different validation criteria. Also note in particular: when the positive rate at a concentration is exactly 100% or 0%, that concentration point does not provide enough information for the probit model to estimate the slope of the curve, so the dilution concentrations must be redesigned, otherwise the goodness of fit of the model will be insufficient.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 引進新一代 AMM/RMM（例如以自動化影像偵測取代傳統無菌試驗培養）而言，LoD95 是最常被監管機關（TFDA、FDA）追問的數字之一，因為它直接關係到「這台機器是否可能漏掉低濃度污染」這種病人安全（Patient Safety）議題——對應到決策階層第 2 順位「Product CQAs 產品關鍵品質屬性」。選擇 probit 分析而非單點式 LoD，能在遞交驗證報告時提供具統計嚴謹度的證據，減少法規審查往返次數，加快新方法上線時程。
blocks.en: For a CDMO introducing a new-generation AMM/RMM (for example, replacing traditional sterility test culture with automated image detection), LoD95 is one of the numbers most often asked about by regulators (TFDA, FDA), because it bears directly on the patient safety question of whether "this machine might miss low-level contamination". This corresponds to the second priority in the decision hierarchy, "Product CQAs (critical quality attributes)". Choosing probit analysis rather than a single-point LoD provides statistically rigorous evidence when the validation report is submitted, reduces back-and-forth in regulatory review and speeds up go-live of the new method.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「只測一次、測到最低濃度就是 LoD」這種做法在統計上站不住腳？probit analysis 解決了什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why is the approach of "test once and the lowest concentration detected is the LoD" statistically untenable? What problem does probit analysis solve?

blocks.zh: MPN 法與 gMPN 法各自的優缺點是什麼？在加菌誤差風險較高的實驗室環境，你會傾向選哪一種？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of the MPN method and the gMPN method respectively? In a laboratory environment with a higher risk of inoculation error, which would you lean towards?

blocks.zh: 若你的 AMM/RMM LoD95 落在 1-2 CFU，你還需要花時間跟 CMM 做直接比較嗎？原文的 MPL 概念如何簡化這個決策？
blocks.en: If your AMM/RMM LoD95 falls at 1-2 CFU, do you still need to spend time on a direct comparison with the CMM? How does the MPL concept in the source simplify this decision?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Specificity（特異性）不需要獨立試驗，只要在 Accuracy、Repeatability、LoD、LoQ、Method Suitability、Comparability 等試驗中使用具代表性的微生物 panel（涵蓋 Gram 陰性/陽性桿菌、產孢菌、球菌、酵母菌、黴菌），即已一併證明；非存活細胞不應被誤判為陽性，逆境菌株不建議使用。
blocks.en: Specificity does not need a separate study. It is demonstrated together whenever a representative panel of microorganisms (covering Gram-negative/Gram-positive rods, spore formers, cocci, yeast and mold) is used in studies such as Accuracy, Repeatability, LoD, LoQ, Method Suitability and Comparability. Nonviable cells should not be misjudged as positive, and stressed organisms are not recommended.

blocks.zh: Accuracy（準確度）透過平行測試（parallel testing）比較 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 的平均回收率，統計方法依資料分布選用 TOST、Poisson/Negative-Binomial 迴歸或無母數方法；允收標準常用 comparability margin 0.7（Δ = 0.3），等效區間 [0.7, 1.3]。
blocks.en: Accuracy compares the mean recovery of the AMM/RMM and the CMM through parallel testing. The statistical method is chosen according to the data distribution: TOST, Poisson/Negative-Binomial regression or nonparametric methods. The commonly used acceptance criterion is a comparability margin of 0.7 (Δ = 0.3), with an equivalence interval of [0.7, 1.3].

blocks.zh: Repeatability（重複性）評估同批菌液、同分析師、同設備下的批內變異，以 RSD/CV 表示，並用 Levene's test（建議 Brown-Forsythe 版本）與 CMM 比較變異數；允收標準常用比值 margin 0.5 或自然對數尺度 margin 0.693。
blocks.en: Repeatability evaluates within-run variability for the same suspension, the same analyst and the same equipment, expressed as RSD/CV, and the variance is compared with the CMM using Levene's test (the Brown-Forsythe version is recommended). The commonly used acceptance criterion is a ratio margin of 0.5 or a natural logarithm scale margin of 0.693.

blocks.zh: Limit of Detection（LoD，偵測極限）建議用 probit/logit analysis 估算 LoD95，每濃度至少 20-40 重複；與 CMM 比較可用 MPN 或 gMPN 法，允收標準同樣採用 Δ = 0.3、等效區間 [0.7, 1.3] 的邏輯；LoD 為 1-2 CFU 時可用 MPL 法簡化流程。
blocks.en: Limit of Detection (LoD): probit/logit analysis is recommended to estimate LoD95, with at least 20-40 replicates per concentration. The comparison with the CMM can use the MPN or gMPN method, and the acceptance criterion follows the same logic of Δ = 0.3 and an equivalence interval of [0.7, 1.3]. When the LoD is 1-2 CFU, the MPL method can be used to simplify the process.

blocks.zh: 四項參數的允收標準設計呈現一致的統計哲學：以「比值型 comparability margin」搭配信賴區間判定，讓驗證團隊能用同一套邏輯思維橫跨不同驗證準則，也便於向多國法規機關溝通同一套科學論證。
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria for the four parameters follow a consistent statistical philosophy: a "ratio-type comparability margin" combined with a confidence interval decision, so that the validation team can use one way of thinking across different validation criteria and can also communicate the same scientific argument to regulatory authorities in several countries.
